div.div:
Pinned path — --traverse / --for-each
Dijkstra skips self-loops (e.g. list_orthologs: one gene id → more gene ids). Name the relationship to force the route THROUGH it; re-root on each child, then plan --want from each. Builds a Braid directly (plan_capability) — bypasses graph search.
